name: chrome_larry_ellison_search
description: Basic browser test to search for Larry Ellison on Google and find the Wikipedia page in search results

environment.operating_system: Any modern OS capable of running Chrome

nodes.content: Open Google Chrome and navigate to Google.com

metadata.expected_result: Google search page is displayed with search box in the center

nodes.content: Click on the Google search box and type 'Larry Ellison'

metadata.expected_result: The search term 'Larry Ellison' appears in the search box

nodes.content: Press Enter to submit the search query

metadata.expected_result: Google search results page for 'Larry Ellison' appears

nodes.content: Look for the Wikipedia page for Larry Ellison in the search results. It should be among the top results. If not immediately visible, scroll down to find it.

metadata.expected_result: The Wikipedia page for Larry Ellison is visible in the search results

nodes.content: Click on the Wikipedia search result for Larry Ellison

metadata.expected_result: The browser navigates to the Wikipedia page for Larry Ellison

nodes.content: Verify that the Wikipedia page for Larry Ellison has loaded by confirming the page title includes 'Larry Ellison' and the Oracle corporation is mentioned in the content.

metadata.expected_result: The Wikipedia page for Larry Ellison is successfully loaded, showing biographical information about the Oracle founder

nodes.content: Extract the first paragraph from the Wikipedia page and find the Personal Life section. Save both texts to an output file.

metadata.expected_result: The first paragraph and Personal Life section text are extracted and saved to a file

verification_steps: Step 1: Verify that Chrome opens and navigates to Google.com
Step 2: Verify that 'Larry Ellison' is entered in the search box
Step 3: Verify that search results appear for 'Larry Ellison'
Step 4: Verify that Wikipedia result is found in the search results
Step 5: Verify that clicking the link opens the Wikipedia page
Step 6: Verify that the Wikipedia page contains information about Larry Ellison and Oracle
